headline: Anthropic launches Claude Ship for automated pull request approval
summary: Anthropic launched Claude Ship, a product that lets Claude review, fix and approve pull requests without human sign-off. Outlets agree the feature targets the growing backlog of AI-generated code awaiting human review.

claims.statement: Anthropic launched Claude Ship, letting Claude review, fix and approve pull requests on its own.

sources.quote: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
As part of a new Claude Ship product being announced today, Claude now can review, fix, and approve pull requests.

claims.statement: The feature aims to remove a bottleneck caused by AI-generated code piling up for human approval.

sources.quote: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.
